title: Resourceful Bees Centrifuge Recipe
description: Draft 2020-12 schema reconstructed from CentrifugeRecipe, ItemOutput, FluidOutput, ResourcefulLib WeightedCollection, Minecraft Ingredient and ItemStackTemplate, and NeoForge FluidStackTemplate.

inputAmount.description: Exact input stack count required by CentrifugeRecipe.matches and consumed when the recipe completes. Uses ExtraCodecs.POSITIVE_INT.

itemOutputs.description: Item output rolls. Runtime result generation evaluates only the first three entries; later entries are ignored.

fluidOutputs.description: Fluid output rolls. Runtime result generation evaluates only the first three entries; later entries are ignored.

time.description: Positive processing time using ExtraCodecs.POSITIVE_INT. Defaults from CentrifugeConfig.defaultCentrifugeRecipeTime; 200 is the stock configuration value.

energyPerTick.description: Positive energy-per-tick value using ExtraCodecs.POSITIVE_INT. Defaults from CentrifugeConfig.centrifugeRfPerTick; 10 is the stock configuration value.

rotations.description: Optional explicit manual-centrifuge rotation count using ExtraCodecs.POSITIVE_INT. When omitted, runtime derives rotations from time.

itemOrTag.description: Common compact Minecraft Ingredient form: direct item identifier or #item tag.

ingredient.description: Minecraft Ingredient.CODEC. Common direct item/tag forms are modeled explicitly; lists and custom Minecraft/NeoForge ingredient objects are kept permissive because their full external codecs are outside Resourceful Bees.

dataComponentPatch.description: Minecraft DataComponentPatch. Component keys are registry-driven and intentionally extensible.

itemStackTemplate.description: Minecraft ItemStackTemplate compact string or expanded object form.

fluidStackTemplate.description: NeoForge FluidStackTemplate. A bare non-empty fluid ID is shorthand for bucket volume with no component patch.

weight.description: FluidOutput codec accepts values from 1.0 through Java Double.MAX_VALUE.

pool.description: Codec-valid when empty, but runtime selection requires a non-empty pool when this roll succeeds.
